name: reviewplane
description: ReviewPlane monorepo root. Individual services live under apps/, services/ and packages/.

scripts.//test:security: The four standing security gates of docs/TESTING.md section 10: cross-project and cross-organisation isolation, stale control commands and the control epoch, prompt injection, and capability degradation. They are ordinary test files, so `pnpm test` already runs them on every change; this script exists so that a release gate can name the condition it owns rather than depending on the whole root suite. Membership is the `security-gate-` filename prefix in each package, so a gate added is a gate this runs. It needs Docker for a disposable PostgreSQL and nothing else — no Compose, no Chromium, no image build. The packages are named rather than discovered with `-r --if-present`, because `pnpm -r --if-present run <missing>` exits 0 having run nothing — measured — so a deleted script would make this command a green no-op, while an explicit filter exits 1. The list is reconciled against the packages that actually hold gate files by a test in apps/server/test/security-gate-isolation.test.ts, so it cannot fall behind them.
